'''Oquan''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its leader was [[Rel Acoi]].<ref name="Talnar" />
